exposure: use of povidone and chlorhexidine for skin preparation
cohort: 201 women aged 15-47 years undergoing Cesarean section at Kibungo Referral Hospital, Rwanda, between February and April 2020.
finding: Showering prior to operation, not shaving 30 minutes prior to incision, and the combined use of povidone and chlorhexidine for skin preparation were associated with a reduced risk of post-CS SSI, while obstructed labor/dystocia increased the risk.
